site.title: Trustpilot
site.short_description: Review site with a free Business company profile. OpenQuok autofills company settings. You verify domain and business email on Trustpilot.
site.long_description: Trustpilot lists companies at trustpilot.com/review/your-domain. Claim your profile in company settings after you sign in. Website links on public profiles are usually nofollow. You need a business email on your company domain.

opportunities.title: Company profile
opportunities.cost_note: Free company profile. Paid Trustpilot plans are separate.
opportunities.description: Claim your company in Trustpilot Business company settings. OpenQuok fills name, domain, description, and logo. Contact info, publish, and verification stay manual. Website links are usually nofollow.

steps.title: Prepare business email
steps.body: Use email on your company domain (for example hello@yourdomain.com). Personal inboxes often fail verification.

steps.title: Autofill company settings
steps.body: Open company settings. Expand About your business and Company description. OpenQuok fills those sections. Enter contact info on Trustpilot if required.

steps.title: Verify domain and email
steps.body: Complete domain and business-email checks on Trustpilot.

steps.title: Save, publish, and check rel
steps.body: Save and publish on Trustpilot. Open your trustpilot.com/review/… page. Confirm nofollow on your website link.
